scope: Test-only observation of real UI turn, manual-save and load producers. No production runtime, save/rollback behavior, model transport, timeout budget or existing formal business assertion is replaced.

sourceIdentity.hashBoundary: The helper, unit test and bridge hashes match the final 21/21 run. provenance.excerptBoundary: These are selected lines copied from tool responses, not synthesized original log files.
provenance.timestampBoundary: The unit tool output did not include absolute execution timestamps. recordedAtUtc is the evidence-writing time and must not be used as the unit execution time.

implementation.turnWitness: The original _tmCommitEndTurnTransaction must return true; its committed transaction, matching GM/P, original turn/load/campaign/timeline and both matching canonical slots are checked.
implementation.saveReceipt: The real global saveToSlot Promise spans name confirmation, queued save-required jobs, storage commit and UI refresh; only an exact true return is accepted.
implementation.loadReceipt: The real loadFromSlot Promise must return true with an idle replacement GM, advanced load generation, same expected campaign/turn and running world. Legitimate loaded timeline forks are permitted.
implementation.transparency: The original producer is called once per invocation with unchanged this/arguments, and the wrapper returns the original Promise object.
implementation.retainedEvidence: Only primitive operation identities and result summaries are emitted. Temporary GM/P identity references are cleared on completion, failure or deadline; txn/ctx are never stored.
implementation.sharedDeadline: One deadlineAt from the existing bridge timer is passed to every operation; no operation receives a fresh duration.
implementation.assertions: Original real UI controls, history-choice checks, review-collapse cancellation check, two reload comparisons, stale detached control check, onsite exchange, actual return and unique memory/learning assertions remain. completed-evidence additionally requires all observed producers completed exactly once.
